cuts.precondition: Forwarder evidence is published and the start intent is pending
cuts.death: Controller receives SIGKILL before the forwarding fact
cuts.recovery: Fresh controller observes the recorded process and adopts the exact evidence
cuts.durableState: Forwarding record committed; no pending start intent
cuts.publication: No duplicate forwarder; exact-process cleanup required at close

cuts.precondition: The service-start intent is durable and the recorded service is not yet facted
cuts.death: Controller receives SIGKILL after service spawn and before the start fact
cuts.recovery: Replacement controller observes the exact helper and child identities before adoption or restart
cuts.durableState: The exact service record is facted or the pending start remains for fail-closed reconciliation
cuts.publication: No duplicate service and no cleanup of an unrelated PID or listener

cuts.transition: SupervisorClaimed, ServiceStart, ServiceRestart, ForwarderStarted, WorkspaceStoppedOrDeleted, ForwardersStopped, ServicesStopped, SupervisorStopped, LeaseReleased
cuts.precondition: Each named closure-rule transition has a durable precondition
cuts.death: SIGKILL at each transition's effect/fact boundary
cuts.recovery: Observation-first reconciliation of only the recorded intent
cuts.durableState: Exact journal facts, lease ownership, pointer state, and cleanup state
cuts.publication: Immutable generation and pointer are unchanged unless their publication cut completed
